non_affiliate_books_note: Display names only, for books that are in the offer universe but earn nothing. Recorded so a fallback selection can be named honestly rather than shown as an opaque key, and recorded separately from the eight affiliate entries so that nothing here can ever be handed a destination. Sources: predictions/api/index.html BOOK_NAMES and predictions/nba-props.html ALL_BOOK_DISPLAY, where every one of these carries affiliate: false. betanysports is deliberately absent from this map and from the affiliate entries alike: it is an affiliate of the site but it is not one of the eight books this page routes, and listing it in either place would invite reading it as BetAnything.
note: The eight books this page routes, their tier, the sportsbook identifiers each is proven to appear under in the authoritative market data, and the destination a click is sent to. Tier and display name come from the product requirement and are authoritative by themselves. An identifier or a destination is not: each is recorded only where site or data evidence proves it, and the evidence is quoted per book. Five of the eight have neither, so they are recorded with empty vendor_keys and a null redirect_book, which the router reads as 'can never match an offer and can never be given a link'. That is deliberate. Nothing in this file may be filled in from a book's name resembling an identifier.

redirect.evidence: predictions/api/go.php holds the affiliate-network destinations for bovada, betonline, betus and betanysports and answers each with HTTP 302. The links themselves stay there and are not reproduced here. predictions/api/live_props.php line 1044 states the site's convention: 'Redirect-only links (spec B.7 -- never direct affiliate URL)'.
redirect.unknown_book_behaviour: go.php redirects an unrecognised book to Bovada rather than refusing. A link built from an unproven identifier would therefore not fail visibly, it would quietly send that book's traffic to Bovada. This is why redirect_book is null wherever the mapping is unproven, and why the router refuses to construct a destination without one.

redirect_note: A click is sent to the site's own redirect rather than to the sportsbook, which is the convention the existing NBA pages follow and which keeps the affiliate-network tracking links in one place on the server instead of copied into this repository. No tracking link, affiliate id, campaign id or click id is recorded here, and none belongs here.
secrets: No credential material is recorded here and none belongs here.
